Early works like [NerfingMVS](9518-nerfingmvs.md) demonstrated that fine-tuning monocular depth estimators on sparse SfM points could guide volume sampling.

More recent approaches have explored distributional losses like Earth Mover’s Distance to handle the uncertainty in monocular priors [11911-depth-guided-nerf-training-via-earth-mover-s-distance.md], and extended supervision to unseen viewpoints to ensure global geometric coherence [Monocular Depth Regularization on Unseen Views].
